Session references are hashed, never persisted in the bundle. Tampered identity without matching digest is refused. Legacy policy fallback is restricted to bundles lacking implementation. Unknown vendor cannot support run-backed authority; same-model and unknown model without vendor difference fail different-actor. Claims bind implementation principal/execution and review run. Cheap gate evasion was tested by R11 mutation and the dedicated unknown-candidate probes. Declaration is not a vendor receipt; no trust policy or containment guarantee was weakened.

The smallest sufficient milestone routing does not execute general tasks; R10 caller integration stays in pose-delegation-task and must be traced deferred-integration. Existing proof and containment paths remain authoritative. A future task using different identity determination or a schema-2 writer using the lossy F09 serializer invalidates these conclusions.
